How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://malda.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 08-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DMMU and DRDC Malda Bank Resource Person Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application form is 08 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Bank Resource Person post?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria include being a retired bank employee with Scale-III or higher, possessing good communication skills, basic computer knowledge, and familiarity with SHG functioning, bookkeeping, and financial inclusion processes.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 62 years as of 01 January 2026. There is no mention of age relaxation for specific categories in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Bank Resource Person position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 1500 to Rs. 2200 per day, with a maximum of 26 working days per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Bank Resource Person post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Bank Resource Person post announced under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Bank Resource Person role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Bank Resource Person post will be based on a Walk-In-Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What are the important dates for the application process?
faq.answer: The application submission starts on 24 August 2026, and the last date for submission is 08 September 2026. The notification was released on 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Malda District, which is https://malda.gov.in/. Always refer to the official website for the most accurate information.
